bank.retain_mission: Extract error trace patterns, bug root causes, test failure post-mortems, regression fixes, environment setup errors, and troubleshooting runbooks. Ignore successful routine builds and non-error outputs.
bank.observations_mission: Track recurring bug types, flaky test behavior, common environment pitfalls, and successful repair patterns across debugging sessions.
bank.reflect_mission: Synthesize a root-cause diagnosis and actionable fix strategy based on past error trace patterns, post-mortems, and verified test failure resolutions.

mental_models.name: Known Bugs & Verified Fixes
mental_models.source_query: What bugs or test failures were previously encountered, what were their root causes, and how were they fixed?

mental_models.name: Troubleshooting & Debug Runbooks
mental_models.source_query: What are the step-by-step diagnostic runbooks, commands, and environment fixes for known build or runtime errors?
